local.description: Node-local ordinal, allocated by the owning registry.

EventKind.description:
What kind of event this is. Dotted segments; the Kernel owns the five of RS-28
and every other kind belongs to the Vocabulary or Module that emits it.

Rule: RS-27.

NodeId.description:
A node in the (future) multi-host deployment. `LOCAL` is the only legal value in v4.0.

Rule: X7 (`00-overview.md`); it qualifies every id of TM-11, SC-6, SB-3 and MA-19.

ResourceId.description:
Names a resource, or a sub-resource, inside the composite tree a Provider declares.

The path is a non-empty sequence of segments; `dev0/rx/0` names channel 0 of the
receive sub-tree of `dev0`. Vision §49 asks only for the node qualification; the
path replaces §49's flat `local` because a channel or a timekeeper must be
addressable (`00-overview.md` "Where these specs depart from the Vision").

Rule: SB-33, SB-34 (`03-spec-and-binding.md`), X7.

path.description: Slash-joined path through the composite resource tree (SB-34).

Severity.description: How bad an event is; RS-29 derives a default reaction from it (Vision §29).

oneOf.description: Something is off but the Run continues.

TimePoint.description:
An instant: integer ticks in a named clock domain. Never floating-point seconds.

There is deliberately no `PartialOrd`: two points of different domains cannot be
compared at all, and `a < b` silently answering `false` is the bug class this
model exists to prevent (decision T3).

Rule: TM-1, TM-6.

ticks.description: Tick count relative to the domain's origin; a sample index in a SampleClock (TM-10).

description:
The control-path form of an event: a source, a `TimePoint` in a named domain, a
severity, a kind and a schema-versioned payload (Vision §29).

Rule: RS-31.

payload.description: The body; its schema belongs to the kind's owner (RS-31).
